_doc: Must-keep fork features (RUNBOOK 'Must-keep fork features'). fork-check runs every `tests` path (relative to CHECKOUT) and every `probes` entry. A probe runs `<channel> <args...>` from /tmp with stdin closed; it passes when the exit code is 0, every `mustMatch` regex matches the combined output and no `mustNotMatch` regex does (Python re, MULTILINE). Add a feature by appending an object.
